recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further FHIR core source work is recommended unless a future link/build check finds a new broken generated Resource-definition target.
issue_request: FHIR-5360 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core ballot comment saying the "resources are defined" link under The Specification did not lead to Resource definitions; the approved resolution was to fix the broken link.
initial_application: Jira comments said the issue was already fixed. No commit message explicitly names FHIR-5360, but commit 1f47641cdc1dfceffec70ed5fbb20c0957674289 changed source/overview.html on 2015-03-12 from resources.html to resource.html for the exact "resources are defined" and "Resource Definitions" links.
additional_context: Current source/overview.html points Resource and Resource Definitions links to resource.html and uses resourcelist.html only for the resource list. source/fhir.ini lists resource as an active abstract infrastructure resource, and the Resource introduction/StructureDefinition supply the Resource definition material. Jira/Zulip/Confluence searches found no later conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the current build-scope source already preserves the broken-link fix.
